entries.description: Pool of tears size contradiction without size potion in Chapter 2.
Mad Tea-Party riddle 'Why is a raven like a writing-desk?' has no canonical answer.
Alice's thimble prize disappears between Chapter 4 and Chapter 5.
Cheshire Cat grin disappears left-to-right in Chapter 6, right-to-left in Chapter 8.
Duchess moral rules contradict Gryphon school rules.
Lobster Quadrille song lyrics change stanza order without explanation.
Rabbit hole dream logic: the entire series of surreal events is revealed as a dream in Chapter 12.
Caterpillar's mushroom edges advice pays off during courtroom testimony in Chapter 11.
White Rabbit's dropped fan returns as Queen's croquet requirement in Chapter 8.
Mouse's tail story poem pays off when meeting the Mock Turtle in Chapter 9.
March Hare's watch butter repair pays off in Lobster Quadrille trial in Chapter 10.
Queen of Hearts croquet trial obligation left pending.
Promise to visit March Hare tea garden.
Mock Turtle promises to recite history of sea school.
Bill the lizard vow to fetch the garden ladder.
Knave of Hearts tarts stolen vow to discover the baker.
Pigeon's nest serpent investigation promise left open.
Caucus-race resolves immediately in Chapter 3.
Cheshire Cat directions to March Hare in Chapter 6.
Dormouse teapot tea-time bedtime story in Chapter 7.
Gryphon lobster dance demonstration in Chapter 10.

payoffs.rationale: Alice wakes on the riverbank: entire wonderland narrative resolved as dream craft in Chapter 12.
Mushroom edges advice pays off when Alice grows in court in Chapter 11.
White Rabbit fan arrives at croquet match in Chapter 8.
Mock Turtle echoes mouse tale in Chapter 9.
Butter watch evidence cited during testimony in Chapter 10.
Caucus race prizes distributed in Chapter 4.
